commands.name: library.open
commands.label: Open Library
commands.description: Show the photo library (the grid of every photo in the added folders).

commands.name: library.stats
commands.label: Library stats
commands.description: Count photos, videos, favourites, hidden, trashed, albums and folders in the library, and report background job progress.

commands.name: library.roots
commands.label: Library folders
commands.description: List the folders added to the library, with their ids and photo counts.

commands.name: library.search
commands.label: Search photos
commands.description: Find photos by words, date range, album, folder, camera, tag, favourite, rating or flag. Returns ids and short details, a page at a time.

q.description: words to match in file name, folder, tags, album names, camera, captions and text read from photos; a year (2024) or month name (March) matches capture dates

from.description: capture date on or after, YYYY-MM-DD

folder.description: folder path inside its root, e.g. "2024/Goa"

tag.description: a tag; a parent tag matches its children

cursor.description: from a previous result, to get the next page

commands.name: library.rescan
commands.label: Rescan folders
commands.description: Look for new, changed and missing files in one added folder, or all of them.

commands.name: library.undo
commands.label: Undo
commands.description: Undo one earlier change to favourites, ratings, flags, tags, hidden photos or albums, by the undo token that change returned. A change that moved files (trash, restore, move, rename) is undone with library.undo_files.

commands.name: library.undo_files
commands.label: Undo a file change
commands.description: Undo one earlier trash, restore, move or rename, by the undo token that change returned. Files on disk move back, so NakliOS asks the person first.

commands.name: library.tags
commands.label: List tags
commands.description: List every tag in the library with how many photos carry it.

commands.name: library.search_meaning
commands.label: Search by meaning
commands.description: Find photos by what they show, for example "a dog on a beach at sunset", using the CLIP vectors made on this device. Needs Search by meaning turned on in the Library.

commands.name: photo.get
commands.label: Photo details
commands.description: Full details of one photo: dates, size, camera, place, tags, albums, rating and flag.

commands.name: photo.thumb
commands.label: Thumbnail
commands.description: A small JPEG or WebP data URL of one photo, for looking at it. About 20 KB.

commands.name: photo.similar
commands.label: Find similar
commands.description: The photos that look most like one photo, by their CLIP vectors. Needs Search by meaning turned on.

commands.name: photo.open
commands.label: Open in editor
commands.description: Open one photo in Slate's editor.

commands.name: photo.favourite
commands.label: Favourite
commands.description: Mark photos as favourites, or unmark them.

dryRun.description: report what would change and change nothing

commands.name: photo.rate
commands.label: Rate
commands.description: Give photos a star rating from 0 (none) to 5.

dryRun.description: report what would change and change nothing

commands.name: photo.flag
commands.label: Pick or reject
commands.description: Flag photos as pick or reject, or clear the flag (none).

dryRun.description: report what would change and change nothing

commands.name: photo.tag
commands.label: Tag
commands.description: Add or remove tags on photos. Use "/" for nested tags, e.g. "trips/goa".

dryRun.description: report what would change and change nothing

commands.name: photo.hide
commands.label: Hide
commands.description: Hide photos from the timeline and search, or show them again. Hidden photos stay in the Hidden view.

dryRun.description: report what would change and change nothing

commands.name: photo.restore
commands.label: Restore from trash
commands.description: Move trashed photos back to where they were. NakliOS asks the person first, because files on disk change. Refuses to overwrite.

dryRun.description: report what would change and change nothing

commands.name: photo.trash
commands.label: Move to trash
commands.description: Move photos into the trash folder (.slate-trash) inside their library folder. They can be restored until the trash is emptied.

dryRun.description: report what would change and change nothing

commands.name: photo.bulk
commands.label: Change many photos
commands.description: Apply one change (favourite, rate, flag, tag, hide, album add or remove) to more than 200 photos at once. NakliOS asks the person first, because the change reaches many photos.

dryRun.description: report what would change and change nothing

commands.name: photo.move
commands.label: Move to folder
commands.description: Move photos to another folder inside the same library folder; XMP sidecars move with them. NakliOS asks the person first, because files on disk change. Refuses to overwrite.

toPath.description: new path inside the same root, e.g. "2024/Goa/IMG_1.jpg"

dryRun.description: report what would change and change nothing

commands.name: photo.rename
commands.label: Rename
commands.description: Rename photos in place from a template with {name}, {date}, {time}, {n} and {camera}. NakliOS asks the person first, because files on disk change. Refuses to overwrite.

template.description: e.g. "{date} Goa {n}"; the extension is kept

dryRun.description: report what would change and change nothing

commands.name: trash.empty
commands.label: Empty trash
commands.description: Permanently delete the files in the trash (all of them, or the given ids). This cannot be undone.

dryRun.description: report what would change and change nothing

commands.name: album.list
commands.label: List albums
commands.description: List albums with their ids, names and photo counts.

commands.name: album.create
commands.label: New album
commands.description: Create an album, optionally with photos in it. Albums hold references; no file moves.

dryRun.description: report what would change and change nothing

commands.name: album.rename
commands.label: Rename album
commands.description: Rename an album.

dryRun.description: report what would change and change nothing

commands.name: album.add
commands.label: Add to album
commands.description: Add photos to an album.

dryRun.description: report what would change and change nothing

commands.name: album.remove
commands.label: Remove from album
commands.description: Take photos out of an album. The photos themselves stay.

dryRun.description: report what would change and change nothing

commands.name: album.cover
commands.label: Set album cover
commands.description: Choose which photo in an album shows as its cover.

dryRun.description: report what would change and change nothing

commands.name: album.delete
commands.label: Delete album
commands.description: Delete an album. Its photos stay in the library.

dryRun.description: report what would change and change nothing

commands.name: image.info
commands.label: Image info
commands.description: Describe the image open in the editor: file name, width and height in pixels, format, and how many edits are in its history.

commands.name: image.open
commands.label: Edit photo
commands.description: Open one library photo (an id from library.search) in the editor, so the image commands work on it.

commands.name: image.crop
commands.label: Crop
commands.description: Crop the open image to a rectangle, in pixels from its top-left corner. Undo with image.undo.

commands.name: image.rotate
commands.label: Rotate
commands.description: Rotate the open image by 90 degrees clockwise (90), anticlockwise (-90), or 180.

commands.name: image.flip
commands.label: Flip
commands.description: Flip the open image horizontally (h, a mirror image) or vertically (v).

commands.name: image.resize
commands.label: Resize
commands.description: Resize the open image to a width and height in pixels (at most 16384 each).

commands.name: image.adjust
commands.label: Adjust
commands.description: Change exposure (-100 to 100, about 2 stops at the ends), contrast (-100 to 100) and saturation (-100 to 200) of the open image. 0 leaves a setting as it is.

commands.name: image.sharpen
commands.label: Sharpen
commands.description: Sharpen the open image. Amount 0.1 to 5; 1 is typical.

commands.name: image.straighten
commands.label: Straighten
commands.description: Rotate the open image by a small angle in degrees (-45 to 45, positive is clockwise). The canvas grows to fit.

commands.name: image.undo
commands.label: Undo edit
commands.description: Undo the last edit to the open image.

commands.name: image.export
commands.label: Export image
commands.description: Save the edited image as a new file: beside the original when the editor has a save folder, otherwise as a download. The original file is never replaced. Returns the file name.

commands.name: image.extract_text
commands.label: Extract text
commands.description: Read printed English text from the open image on this device. Downloads Tesseract.js (about 5 MB, from esm.sh and jsDelivr) the first time: ask the person, then pass allowDownload: true. Returns the text and a confidence from 0 to 100.

allowDownload.description: set true, after the person agreed, to allow the first-time download

commands.name: image.lens_blur
commands.label: Background blur
commands.description: Blur the background by depth, keeping the subject at a focus point sharp. x and y are 0 to 1 across the image. Downloads the depth model (about 27 to 50 MB, from Hugging Face) the first time: ask the person, then pass allowDownload: true. Undo with image.undo.

allowDownload.description: set true, after the person agreed, to allow the first-time download

commands.name: image.snapshot
commands.label: Snapshot
commands.description: A small JPEG data URL of the open image as it looks now (at most 512 px on the long edge), for looking at it.
